name: Zettai Fukujuu♪ ~Sensei wa Watashi-tachi no Kawaii Maso Pet~
original_name: 絶対服従♪～先生は私達の可愛いマゾペット～
source:
Our protagonist Eitarou Suzuki has recently assigned to a girls' 
school as a math teacher and a homeroom teacher of B class.
He lives in harem-ish days as he is literally surrounded by schoolgirls.

One day, he has got to take care of one of his student Momoko's 
study after school. This brings a significant change to his fate......

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE230992.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我们的主角铃木荣太郎最近被分配到了女子组 
学校担任数学老师和B班班主任。
他生活在后宫般的日子里，因为他的周围都是女学生。

有一天，他必须照顾他的一名学生桃子的孩子 
放学后学习。这给他的命运带来了重大的改变……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE230992.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
